labels.text: section 63(c)(2)(B), as modified by section 63(c)(7) for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2017: the basic standard deduction for a head of household

section 63(c)(2)(B): $4,400, unindexed statutory base; before inflation adjustment under section 63(c)(4) (base year 1987) — no Rev. Proc. published amount for any pre-2018 year is pinned here (SOURCE_GAP)

section 63(c)(7)(A)(i): $18,000, unindexed statutory base for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2017 and before January 1, 2026 (pre-amendment text as pinned in the 2024 Edition); before inflation adjustment under section 63(c)(7)(B)(ii) (base year 2017) — no Rev. Proc. published amount for 2018-2024 is pinned here (SOURCE_GAP)

Pub. L. 119-21, div. B, title VII, subtitle A, ch. 1, section 70102(b)(1), 139 Stat. 159 (July 4, 2025): substitutes $23,625 for $18,000 in section 63(c)(7)(A)(i)/(B)(ii), applicable to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024, and (per section 70102(a)) with no further sunset. Before inflation adjustment under section 63(c)(7)(B)(ii) as amended (base year 2024) — no Rev. Proc. published amount for 2025 or later is pinned here (SOURCE_GAP). NOT pinned as a package `source`/`fragment` (see companion `basic-standard-deduction-other.lawparam.json` note).
